partlet.definition:
n. A covering for the neck, and sometimes for the shoulders
   and breast; originally worn by both sexes, but laterby women alone; a
   ruff.
n. A hen; -- so called from the ruffing of her neck feathers.
partlet.translation: n. 打褶绣花的紧身小衫

partly.definition: r in part; in some degree; not wholly
partly.translation: adv. 部分地, 在一定程度上

partly secured creditors.translation: [经] 有部份担保的债权人
